product.olivetti-m300-05.summary: The entry-level M300 with integrated VGA and disk and tape options.
product.olivetti-m300-05.history: In September 1991 Olivetti placed the M300-05 in its entry-level workstation range. The catalogue offered 40 or 120 MB disks and tape options.
product.olivetti-m300-05.architecture: Expansion depends on the configuration. The guide lists three 16-bit connectors on IN283 and the 1991 catalogue lists four available. The guide identifies PVGA1B and the DP8473 floppy controller.
product.olivetti-m300-05.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records 1.08.
product.olivetti-m300-05.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m300-05.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m300-05.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, 18-1.
